{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent estimand description for PRO endpoint",
      "quote": "Change from baseline to Week 14 in PRO endpoints between AMG 510 and docetaxel, for with KRAS p.G12C mutation.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The PRO estimand description states 'Week 14' while the endpoint definition and attributes state 'Week 12'. This inconsistency will confuse analysis and reporting.",
      "fix": "Align the estimand description to 'Week 12' or correct the endpoint definition to 'Week 14' consistently."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing definition of 'treatment-emergent' adverse events",
      "quote": "Subject incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events, treatment-related adverse events, changes in vital signs, and clinical laboratory tests.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The term 'treatment-emergent' is used but not defined in the synopsis or body. Without a clear definition, AE reporting may be inconsistent.",
      "fix": "Add a definition of treatment-emergent adverse events (e.g., events occurring after first dose and within 30 days after last dose)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Incomplete description of trial design: no mention of blinding or control details",
      "quote": "This is a phase 3, multicenter, randomized, open label, active-controlled, study to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of AMG 510 versus docetaxel",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The design description lacks details on the control arm (docetaxel) regimen, dose, and schedule, and does not specify blinding of BICR (though mentioned later). This is a thin section per the rules engine.",
      "fix": "Add a full description of the trial design including control arm details, blinding of BICR, and randomization ratio."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing rationale for trial design",
      "quote": "The study will consist of a screening period, a treatment period, a safety follow-up (SFU) period, and long-term follow-up period.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The rationale for choosing an open-label, active-controlled design with crossover is not provided. This is a missing section per the rules engine.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection explaining the rationale for the open-label design, choice of docetaxel as control, and crossover approach."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent crossover description: 'early efficacy' vs 'DMC'",
      "quote": "Alternatively, should an early efficacy of the study be noted by the DMC, crossover will be considered for all subjects who randomized into the docetaxel arm",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The phrase 'early efficacy of the study be noted by the DMC' is vague and inconsistent with standard DMC roles (safety monitoring). It may lead to misinterpretation of crossover criteria.",
      "fix": "Clarify the DMC's role and the specific criteria for early crossover, or rephrase to 'if the DMC recommends based on interim efficacy results'."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing details on treatment beyond progression and crossover",
      "quote": "See Section 99.1.6 and Section 8.1.7 for AMG 510 and docetaxel treatment beyond radiologic progression. See Section 8.1.8 for crossover.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The synopsis references sections that are not provided in the text, leaving the reader without details on treatment beyond progression and crossover procedures.",
      "fix": "Include the referenced sections or summarize the key rules for treatment beyond progression and crossover in the synopsis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing sample size determination and power calculations",
      "quote": "Approximately 330 previously treated subjects with locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic NSCLC with centrally confirmed KRAS p.G12C mutation will be enrolled and randomized 2:1",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The sample size is stated but no justification or power calculation is provided. This is a missing section per the rules engine (M11 10.11).",
      "fix": "Add a sample size determination section with assumptions for PFS hazard ratio, alpha, power, and dropout rates."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent timing of tumor assessments",
      "quote": "every 6 weeks from cycle 1 day 1; (± 7 days) (at weeks 7, 13, 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, and 49), and then at 9 week intervals (± 7 days) thereafter",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The schedule lists weeks 7, 13, 19, etc., which are 6-week intervals, but the text says 'every 6 weeks' and then '9 week intervals'—the transition point is not specified, and the listed weeks are inconsistent with 6-week intervals from day 1 (week 0 would be 6, 12, 18...).",
      "fix": "Clarify the assessment schedule: specify the exact weeks for 6-weekly assessments and the point at which 9-weekly intervals begin."
    }
  ]
}
